paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training loss curves for different configurations of the SepLLM model during a post-training setting, with the loss value shown on the y-axis and the number of iterations on the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 in linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from approximately 95,000 to 125,000 iterations, also on a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 5,000. Four distinct lines are plotted: a magenta line with circular markers and a solid line representing “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”; a blue line with circular markers and a solid line for “SepLLM (n=128)” ; an orange line with circular markers and a solid line for “SepLLM (n=64)” ; and a red dashed line with circular markers representing “Vanilla before post-training.” The magenta line starts at a loss value of approximately 3.0 at iteration 95,000 and decreases to about 2.2 by iteration 125,000. The blue line begins at approximately 3.0 at iteration 95,000 and declines to about 2.3 by iteration 125,000. The orange line starts near 3.0 at iteration 95,000 and decreases to approximately 2.3 by iteration 125,000. The red dashed line remains constant at a loss value of 2.4 throughout the entire range of iterations from 95,000 to 125,000.
